story.title: Judge rejects lawsuit to stop deal extending Dallas Cowboys lease of AT&T Stadium without election
story.summary: The suit stemmed from city council’s decision to use existing stadium sales taxes to make improvements to the venue to keep the Cowboys. A Tarrant County judge has rejected a lawsuit against the City of Arlington that sought to stop an agreement to extend the Dallas Cowboys lease of AT&T Stadium. The suit stems from a decision by the council to use existing stadium sales taxes to make improvements to the venue to keep the Cowboys in the city. Filed by Voters’ Voice of Arlington, an unincorporated non-profit represented by Arlington-based attorney Warren V. Norred, the suit alleged the city illegally bypassed voters to approve the use of sales tax funds. The deal approved by council in April would see the Cowboys’ lease of the city-owned stadium extended to 2055, with a commitment from the city to reimburse up to $273 million in improvements to the venue.
